392	- Pip stays in basic mode until the parent chooses.

395	
396	Every device runs basic mode with no brain, no consent, and only the traffic FR-7.3 lists. It includes care actions, play, the room, sleep, tap-teach, word cards, keepsakes, the diary, and dreams. Realizes UJ-2, UJ-5, UJ-12.

399	- Basic mode runs:
400	  - before the unlock, and after a refund;
401	  - on the server tier while offline, before consent, after consent is revoked, while the server is unavailable, after the talk allowance is used up, and after the guaranteed date;
402	  - on the on-device tier while the model downloads, and after the parent removes it.
403	- Every basic-mode feature passes its tests with networking disabled.
404	- In basic mode, the device sends nothing except:
405	  - the service-configuration fetch (FR-94, no stable identifier) and, on a linked device, the link check (FR-94);
406	  - what a parent chose to send or request in the parent area (FR-64, FR-68, FR-69.1, FR-70–FR-72, FR-74, FR-86, FR-87, FR-102, FR-103);
407	  - model downloads (FR-95);

content.text:
FR-7.3 is the third bullet under FR-7's "Consequences (testable)" in the PRD. It is the closed list of what the device may send in basic mode: "the device sends nothing except" the items below.

- The service-configuration fetch (FR-94, no stable identifier). On a linked device it also includes the link check (FR-94).
- What a parent chose to send or request in the parent area (FR-64, FR-68, FR-69.1, FR-70–FR-72, FR-74, FR-86, FR-87, FR-102, FR-103).
- Model downloads (FR-95).
- Server-credential requests by an unlocked device (FR-88).
- The US referral count (FR-104).
- Store traffic (Google Play purchases and age signal).

Each exception follows its own authorization and retention rules, and child speech is never sent in basic mode. A parent's offline request is sent only when a connection returns. Counters and crash reports need the parent's opt-in `[ASSUMPTION: CQ-21]`. Credential requests need the unlock and active consent.
